{{Quote|Now, I should let you get back to the fight. Only&mdash;before you go&mdash;if I might beg an indulgence of you and ask for word of young Anakin? I had thought to invite him to speak about the Jedi life with a delegation from the Rantofaran Conglomerate but I can't seem to find him.|Supreme Chancellor Palpatine to Jedi Master Yoda|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref>}}
The '''Rantofaran Conglomerate''' was an organization that existed during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] enquired to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] about the location of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and claimed that he sought for Skywalker to speak to a delegation from the Rantofaran Conglomerate about the life of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege" />
